title: Visa to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference
summary: SAN FRANCISCO --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 24, 2026-- Visa (NYSE: V) today announced its participation in the following investor conference. On Tuesday, September 8, Ryan McInerney, Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference.
body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 24, 2026-- Visa (NYSE: V) today announced its participation in the following investor conference.


On Tuesday, September 8, Ryan McInerney, Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference. The discussion will begin at 1:05 p.m. Pacific Time and last for approximately 35 minutes.


A listen-only audio webcast and replay will be accessible for 30 days following the event and available on the Investor Relations website at[investor.visa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.visa.com%2F&esheet=54593426&newsitemid=20260824692493&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.visa.com&index=1&md5=b40d8caf221c73b27f909ccaf0eda1c8) .


About Visa


Visa (NYSE: V) is a world leader in digital payments, facilitating transactions between consumers, sellers, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses and economies to thrive. We believe that economies that include everyone everywhere, uplift everyone everywhere and see access as foundational to the future of money movement. Learn more at[Visa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.visa.com&esheet=54593426&newsitemid=20260824692493&lan=en-US&anchor=Visa.com&index=2&md5=a25473ac35bb465ff803bafacc3623ac) .
